extension.description: Installs and updates the NikeFlix Family build: verified downloads, five profiles, no start-up pop-ups. It never erases a device's existing Family profiles: those devices move with the NikeFlix migration, which keeps each person's sign-ins and watch history.
extension.news: 4.0.1 - New look: a home card with the build artwork and one clear button (Install, Update or Reinstall) - Everything is asked once, up front; a phased progress screen replaces the chain of pop-ups - Backup, restore and maintenance under Tools, in the same style - Christmas artwork from December 1 to December 26, by date 4.0.0 - NikeFlix Family next generation (Kodi 21.3): new nikeflix-family-dist build feed with sha256 verification - Fresh devices: clean five-profile install (safety backup first) - Devices with Family profiles: never erased; they move with the NikeFlix migration - Installs the build's add-on origin seed and the official-only update settings - Optional Fen 4 fallback installer (from its author, hash-verified) - No start-up pop-ups in any profile; semantic version checks; verified self-update
